usage: icebath memory [-h] {setup,status,off,reset} ...

Set up and manage external memory provider plugins. Bundled providers: retaindb, byterover.
Catalog providers (e.g. honcho, hindsight, supermemory, mem0, openviking, holographic): icebath
plugins install <name>. Only one external provider can be active at a time. Built-in memory
(MEMORY.md/USER.md) is always active.

positional arguments:
  {setup,status,off,reset}
    setup               Interactive provider selection and configuration
    status              Show current memory provider config
    off                 Disable external provider (built-in only)
    reset               Erase all built-in memory (MEMORY.md and USER.md)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
